method: Independent agent applied the staged skill to four frozen miniature PRs without the expected answers. Root compared the report with the supplied behavior and contracts.

results.observation: Found physical-read readiness defect and weak preinitialized test; used actual release target branch.
Identified hardware skip, shared expected-value helper, discarded transfer arguments, and bypassed dispatch as distinct coverage gaps; did not invent a production bug.
No false findings for a documented bit format, two distinct branch observations, explicit suffix convention, or supported zero-layer fallback.
Found missing software timing and unstable row identity; accepted documentation-only remedies and made no unsupported timing claim.

limitations: Behavioral validation of instructions against supplied artifacts; no original PR tests or benchmarks were rerun.
